script: Trilobites had eyes made of calcite, a kind of crystal. They first appeared more than 520 million years ago. They lasted for roughly 270 million years. Many could roll up into a ball, like a pill bug. More than 20,000 species have been described from fossils. They died out in the Great Dying, about 252 million years ago.
